refusals.law: MANDATE CLAUSE 15 ('A separated stem is analysis-grade and may never be shipped') + D-SSM-24 (Google-only, which removed SoulX-Singer)
refusals.reason: No Google service generates a vocal-only signal. The only Google sung surface (lyria-3-pro-preview) returns a MIXED song, so an isolated vocal can only be obtained by separating that mix ΓÇö and CLAUSE 15 forbids shipping a separated stem.
refusals.not_a_workaround: Turning the TTS route into the delivered vocal was the OLD fallback and the research itself calls it a downgrade ('upgrades it from "align TTS onto a bed"'). It is not offered here as a substitute.
refusals.what_is_still_lawful: The sung take is delivered AS A WHOLE by lyria-3-pro-preview (single-path), and its separated vocal is used for MEASUREMENT only ΓÇö which is exactly what the A8 intelligibility gate needs.
what_would_unblock_it: a Google/Vertex surface that generates a vocal-only take (none known; would need a capability probe, and a printed enum is never capability evidence ΓÇö MANDATE CLAUSE 6)
his explicit suspension of CLAUSE 15 for this case, which is his decision and not mine
